# Boris Ledger

Fictional offer architect: the offer does the selling and the copy only explains it. Part of [[copywriting-legends]].

## Core ideas
- **Value stack:** list every component with its own reason to exist before the price appears.
- **Risk reversal:** the seller carries the risk so the buyer can say yes; a conditional guarantee beats an unconditional one.
- **Scarcity must be real:** a cap or a deadline only works when it is enforced.

## What to steal
- **Price anchoring:** show the cost of the problem before the price of the solution, see [[anchor-frames]].
- **Bonus as objection killer:** each bonus answers one objection by name.

## Worked example — an offer for a made-up bakery course
- Stack: recipes, a starter kit and a weekly call; the guarantee is conditional on doing the work.
